LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION: READING STRATEGIES • SKIMMING • SCANNING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies • skimming • scanning
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies • skimming • scanning, part of Strand 6 in Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How is reading important in acquiring information?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly to select a story on the theme- the farm,

2. skim through the passage to identify the main idea,

3. scan for specific information from the passage (e.g. names of characters and vocabulary items)

4. conduct a readers’ theatre to read a passage related to the theme aloud,

5. work with peers to answer questions based on the passage,

6. select vocabulary from the passage and list them on flashcards,

7. make sentences using the vocabulary from a substitution table,

8. work collaboratively to play language games involving vocabulary from digital devices.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly to select a story on the theme- the farm,
2. skim through the passage to identify the main idea,
3. scan for specific information from the passage (e.g. names of characters and vocabulary items)
4. conduct a readers’ theatre to read a passage related to the theme aloud,
5. work with peers to answer questions based on the passage,
6. select vocabulary from the passage and list them on flashcards,
7. make sentences using the vocabulary from a substitution table,
8. work collaboratively to play language games involving vocabulary from digital devices.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies • skimming • scanning together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem-solving: This is developed as the learner explores different options when making

sentences using the vocabulary from a substitution table.

• Creativity and Imagination: This is developed as the learner makes connections between concepts when working

collaboratively to play language games involving vocabulary from digital devices.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is acquired as the learner takes up their assigned role when conducting a readers’ theatre to read a

passage related to the theme aloud.

• Peace: This is developed as the learner teams up with others when answering questions based on the passage.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Climate change is addressed as learners interact with concepts on the farm and how climate affects farm practices.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate vocabulary acquired from the theme to their learning of the farm in Agriculture.
